# Counterfeit detection


The task in this assignment is to detect the counterfeit banknotes. The data set is based on [banknote authentication Data Set](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/banknote+authentication#) from UCI Machine Learning repository. The first four columns denote different parameters obtained from the photographs of the banknotes and last column provides the label. We assume that label 1 (positive) denotes the counterfeits.

# Problem 1

Train a neural network classifier to predict counterfeit banknotes. Use the features `a0` and `a3`. Calculate the confusion matrix and AUC score.

```{python}
import torch
import torch.nn as tnn
```

```{python}
features = [0, 3]   #  a0 and a3
nf = len(features)
```

```{python}
features_train = torch.from_numpy(data_train.values[:, features]).to(dtype=torch.float32)
labels_train   = torch.from_numpy(data_train.values[:, 4:5]).to(dtype=torch.float32)
```

```{python}
features_test = torch.from_numpy(data_test.values[:, features]).to(dtype=torch.float32)
labels_test   = torch.from_numpy(data_test.values[:, 4:5]).to(dtype=torch.float32)
```

## Model definition

Small two-layer MLP: 2 inputs> 8 hidden > 1 output.
Binary Cross-Entropy (BCELoss) is used for a binary classification problem with a sigmoid output

```{python}
torch.manual_seed(seed)

model = tnn.Sequential(
    tnn.Linear(in_features=nf, out_features=8),
    tnn.ReLU(),
    tnn.Linear(8, 1),
    tnn.Sigmoid()
)

print(model)
```

```{python}
from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, roc_auc_score, confusion_matrix, accuracy_score
```

```{python}
loss_fn   = tnn.BCELoss()
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.01)
```

## Training loop

50 eras x 500 epochs = 25 000 gradient steps

```{python}
train_accs, test_accs = [], []

for era in range(50):
    for epoch in range(500):
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        pred = model(features_train)
        loss = loss_fn(pred, labels_train)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

    with torch.no_grad():
        pred_tr  = model(features_train)
        acc_train = torch.mean(0.0 + ((pred_tr  > 0.5) == (labels_train > 0.5))).item()
        pred_te  = model(features_test)
        acc_test  = torch.mean(0.0 + ((pred_te  > 0.5) == (labels_test  > 0.5))).item()

    train_accs.append(acc_train)
    test_accs.append(acc_test)

    if (era + 1) % 10 == 0:
        print(f'Era {era+1:3d}  |  train acc: {acc_train}  |  test acc: {acc_test}')
```

```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(9, 4))
plt.plot(train_accs, label='Train accuracy')
plt.plot(test_accs,  label='Test accuracy')
plt.xlabel('Era')
plt.ylabel('Accuracy')
plt.title('Learning curve')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Evaluation on the test set

```{python}
y_true = labels_test.numpy().flatten().astype(int)

with torch.no_grad():
    y_proba     = model(features_test).numpy().flatten()
    y_predicted = (y_proba > 0.5).astype(int)
```

### Confusion Matrix

```{python}
print('Accuracy:', accuracy_score(y_true, y_predicted))
print()
print(classification_report(y_true, y_predicted, target_names=['genuine (0)', 'counterfeit (1)']))
```

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5))
ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(
    y_true, y_predicted,
    display_labels=['genuine', 'counterfeit'],
    colorbar=False, ax=ax
)
ax.set_title('Confusion matrix test set')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

### AUC and ROC curve

```{python}
auc = roc_auc_score(y_true, y_proba)
print(f'AUC score: {auc}')

fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_true, y_proba)

plt.figure(figsize=(7, 6))
plt.plot(fpr, tpr, lw=2, label=f'ROC curve (AUC = {auc})')
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', label='Random classifier')
plt.xlabel('False positive rate')
plt.ylabel('True positive rate')
plt.title('ROC Curve : Neural Network (a0, a3)')
plt.legend(loc='lower right')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

### Decision boundary in feature space (a0 vs a3)

```{python}
x0_range = np.linspace(features_test[:, 0].min().item() - 0.5,
                        features_test[:, 0].max().item() + 0.5, 300)
x1_range = np.linspace(features_test[:, 1].min().item() - 0.5,
                        features_test[:, 1].max().item() + 0.5, 300)
xx0, xx1 = np.meshgrid(x0_range, x1_range)
grid = torch.tensor(np.c_[xx0.ravel(), xx1.ravel()], dtype=torch.float32)

with torch.no_grad():
    zz = model(grid).numpy().reshape(xx0.shape)

plt.figure(figsize=(9, 7))
cf = plt.contourf(xx0, xx1, zz, levels=np.linspace(0, 1, 51), cmap='RdBu_r', alpha=0.7)
plt.contour(xx0, xx1, zz, levels=[0.5], colors='black', linewidths=2)
plt.colorbar(cf, label='P(counterfeit)')

X_te = features_test.numpy()
plt.scatter(X_te[y_true == 0, 0], X_te[y_true == 0, 1],
            c='blue', edgecolors='k', s=30, alpha=0.6, label='genuine')
plt.scatter(X_te[y_true == 1, 0], X_te[y_true == 1, 1],
            c='red',  edgecolors='k', s=30, alpha=0.6, label='counterfeit')
plt.xlabel('a0')
plt.ylabel('a3')
plt.title('Decision boundary (black line is 0.5 threshold)')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Summary

Features used: a0, a3
Arch: 2 -> 8 (ReLU) -> 1 (Sigmoid)
Loss: Binary Cross-Entropy
Training 50 eras x 500 epochs
The model achieves a good AUC score, the confusion matrix and classification report detail per-class precision and recall.
The decision boundary plot shows how the network partitios the 2D feature space.
